Do you enjoy working across technical, commercial, and project domains to shape competitive and executable solutions? To strengthen our work with bids and proposals, we are looking for a Project Capture Manager who will assume a pivotal role in delivering winning proposals.

Your Role

The Project Capture Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end development of customer proposals, ensuring alignment between technical, commercial, legal, and business stakeholders. The role bridges technical solution design, program planning, cost estimation, and commercial governance to deliver high-quality, competitive, and compliant proposals.

Your tasks include:

• Proposal Coordination & Governance: Coordinate and synchronize proposal activities across technical teams, Sales, and Business Management, acting as the central point of contact and remain engaged through to contract signature, working with Legal & Contract Managers to ensure that technical solutions, assumptions, schedules, and resource commitments are robust, realistic, and executable, challenging them where required.

• Proposal Content Development: Contribute to key proposal sections including execution approach, governance, milestones, and risks, while developing schedules and ensuring content is consistent, compliant, and aligned with requirements.

• Business Alignment: Align proposal activities with bid strategies and business priorities, ensuring support for commercial objectives, risk appetite, and long-term goals.

• Cost, Price & Estimation: Lead and support estimation activities, validating scope, assumptions, and risks, and ensuring a solid and traceable foundation for cost and pricing in collaboration with Sales and Business Management.

• Process & Standardization: Drive standardization and continuous improvement of proposal processes, templates, tools, and methodologies in collaboration with PMO and Capture teams.

• Proposal Capability Development: Strengthen proposal practices and methodologies to improve quality, efficiency, scalability, and alignment with organizational growth.

The Project Capture Manager is a highly central and important role in delivering professional and competitive proposals and is therefore key to the successful capture of new projects. You’ll work closely with:

• Engineering Capture Manager

• Sales Managers, Business Development, and Solution Managers

• Legal & Contract Managers

• PMO & Project Management

• Senior Business Management

Short- and Long-Term Success

In the first 6–12 months, success means:

• Delivering structured, high‑quality proposals aligned with customer and business requirements

• Establishing strong collaboration across engineering, sales, and business stakeholders

• Creating clear and reliable project plans, cost estimates, and proposal content

Longer term, you’ll take ownership of maturing proposal capabilities across the organization, improving consistency and competitiveness, and contributing directly to winning complex projects and driving business growth.

What You Bring

You are a structured and commercially aware professional with a balanced approach to competitiveness, risk, and execution quality, supported by expertise in cost estimation, pricing, and risk assessment. You have a demonstrated ability to coordinate and align technical, commercial, legal, and business stakeholders, and to lead structured end-to-end bid processes covering timelines, deliverables, and dependencies.

You likely:

• Have a technical background (e.g., engineering or equivalent) combined with a business or commercial education, enabling a strong commercial mindset and solid technical and project understanding.

• Have solid experience in project or program management, including planning, governance, and execution.

• Ideally, have proven experience in proposal, bid, or capture management within complex, cross-functional environments, including development of high-quality, competitive, and compliant proposals.

• Can contribute to proposal content such as execution plans, schedules, and risk frameworks.

• Have experience with process standardization and continuous improvement, ideally in collaboration with a PMO.

Who You Are

You’re not just coordinating proposals - you are the person who makes the proposals coherent, competitive, and executable. You understand the importance of alignment, quality, and realism in securing new business.

You bring:

• Strong negotiation, customer communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with a high attention to detail and quality.

• The ability to manage multiple deadlines and perform effectively under pressure in a dynamic environment.

• Helpfulness: You support stakeholders and ensure alignment across teams

• Structure and clarity: You create clear overviews, timelines, and deliverables across complex bids

• Human insight: You understand how technical, commercial, and organizational perspectives must align

You’re analytical, detail‑oriented, and able to operate under pressure while maintaining quality and overview. You enjoy working in a dynamic environment where priorities shift—and where your work directly contributes to winning new business.

At GomSpace, we’re on a mission to shape the future of space – one mission at a time. Here, you’ll be part of something bigger than just a project or a product. You’ll help build systems that connect people, enable science, and expand humanity’s reach beyond Earth.

The role requires candidates to be within commuting distance of our office locations to work according to our hybrid work arrangement. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality clinical trial supplies for both early and late-stage trials.

As a Senior Manager, Global Clinical Drug Supply, you will play a pivot role supporting the development and execution of clinical drug demand forecasts and supply plans to ensure uninterrupted delivery of clinical development products across Genmab’s pipeline. Your responsibilities will include managing the demand planning and supply planning of clinical supplies. Job description

Trackman is the leading brand in its field, trusted by elite athletes worldwide. We’re growing and looking for a Senior Full Stack SDET who is passionate about quality engineering and excited to help test and improve world-class sports technology products.

This senior, full-stack quality engineering role spans backend API testing and frontend (Windows and web) application testing. You’ll combine strong automation skills with the ability to define end-to-end quality strategies across the Trackman ecosystem—from radar data pipelines to TM Performance Studio used by athletes and coaches worldwide.

You’ll join an international team and help elevate quality practices by mentoring peers, partnering closely with developers, product owners, and UI/UX designers, and championing a quality-first approach throughout the development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Design, build, and maintain robust test automation frameworks for both backend APIs (REST/GraphQL), web applications and Windows desktop applications

• 
Architect end-to-end test strategies covering integration, system, performance, and regression testing

• 
Lead test planning and review sessions within Agile/Scrum ceremonies alongside developers and product owners

• 
Drive quality across the full stack: from data ingestion APIs and cloud services through to client-facing Windows/Web applications

• 
Define and enforce test coverage standards, reporting metrics, and quality gates within CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)

• 
Explore and implement AI-assisted testing techniques — including AI-generated test cases, intelligent test prioritisation, and anomaly detection — to increase testing efficiency and coverage

• 
Mentor and guide junior QA engineers and SDETs across the team

• 
Collaborate with DevOps and platform engineers to embed testing earlier in the development pipeline (shift-left)

• 
Participate in design reviews and contribute to technical architecture discussions from a testability perspective

• 
Conduct exploratory and risk-based testing to uncover edge cases beyond automated suites

Job requirements

The Ideal Candidate

• 
Holds a relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent (bachelor's level minimum)

• 
Has 5+ years of experience in quality engineering or SDET roles, with proven seniority in at least two of: backend API testing, desktop/Windows application testing, or test framework architecture

• 
Is highly proficient in C# for test automation, with strong understanding of object-oriented design principles.

• 
Has hands-on experience with API testing tools and frameworks (e.g., RestEaze, Postman, Playwright, SpecFlow, or similar)

Has experience testing Windows/Web based applications and understands UI automation frameworks

• 
Is experienced with Azure DevOps or equivalent CI/CD platforms for pipeline integration and test reporting

• 
Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to diagnose complex, cross-layer defects

AI & Emerging Technologies

• Has experience with and understands how AI and machine learning concepts can be applied within a quality engineering context

It Will Also Be a Plus If You Have

• 
Experience in the gaming or sports technology industry

• 
Knowledge of radar, computer vision, or sensor data systems

• 
Golf knowledge or broader sports interest — you don't need to be a pro, but a genuine passion for sports helps!

We Offer

• 
A senior, high-impact role in which you will directly shape Trackman's quality engineering culture and practices

• 
The chance to work with and test the world's leading sports tracking technology, trusted by elite athletes across golf, baseball, and football

• 
A collaborative, cross-functional team with 40+ highly skilled colleagues from more than 35 nationalities

Join SAS Cabin Crew – Opportunities Across Scandinavia

SAS is expanding—connecting people, cultures, and destinations like never before, and we invite you to be part of the journey.

• Copenhagen

• Be at least 18 years old ( 20 years old for Norway base location)

• Have completed high school education or equivalent

• Be between 160 cm and 190 cm tall (without shoes)

• Have a minimum of 2 years’ experience in a customer-facing role

• Be fluent in English, both spoken and written

• Have strong swimming skills

• Hold a valid EU passport allowing free travel worldwide

• Be able to work irregular hours, including weekends and public holidays

• Meet local residency and commuting requirements for your selected base location

• Be able to comply with SAS uniform regulations

The successful candidate

Experience from hospitality, sales, food & beverage service, restaurants, hotels, catering, or events is considered an advantage.

Previous Cabin Crew experience is considered an advantage but is not required for all positions.

• Valid EASA Attestation and Medical

• Minimum one year of continuous experience as Senior Cabin Crew within the past five years

• Employment requires an approved Security Assessment, including a security interview, 5-year background check, reference checks, and an exhaustive police certificate/clean record.

• Successful completion of the training course and meeting all company requirements for Cabin Crew employment.

• Good physical and mental health, as well as good vision (+/- 0.7 with or without correction). Candidates must be able to obtain medical approval according to EASA regulations. • Strong team players with a positive and professional attitude

• Passionate about service, food, and guest experience

• Structured, punctual, and able to stay ahead in a busy environment

• Calm under pressure with strong problem-solving skills
